Install **middleshare-VERSION.apk** for lightweight, offline image conversion.

Video downloads are optional: also install **middleshare-video-VERSION-arm64-v8a.apk** (most modern phones), **armeabi-v7a** (older 32-bit phones), or **x86_64** (compatible emulators/devices). Choose **universal** if unsure; it is much larger. Keep both apps installed, then share video links to the main MiddleShare app.

Both apps are signed with the same release key. Download matching APKs from this release. Android may ask you to allow installation from your browser/files app. Existing debug installations use a different key and must be uninstalled before installing release APKs; this resets settings.

SHA256SUMS lists checksums for every APK. Third-party licenses and source links are available in each app's About page. Source archives for this tag appear below.
